noConnection.troubleshooting.body:
<olist><litem>Make sure your mobile device is within Bluetooth range (about 9 m/30 ft) of the light.</litem><litem>Make sure the light is connected to power and turned on.</litem><litem>Try closing the app completely and reopening it.</litem><litem>Toggle Bluetooth off and on in your mobile device's settings.</litem><litem>Disconnect the light from power (unplug the lamp or flip the wall switch), and then reconnect it.</litem><litem>Try deleting the light from your system and adding it again.</litem></olist>

Still having trouble? Contact our Support team or check out our Support FAQs.

uc.bleLightCommissioning.helpScreen.subt:
<olist><litem>Turn the light off (i.e., disconnecting it from power). Wait 10 seconds, and then turn the light back on.</litem><litem>Make sure you are within <emph>1 ft</emph> of the light you want to connect.</litem><litem>For a <emph>Go accent light</emph>: Press and hold the button on the bottom for 10 seconds until the light blinks, and then press the button again to turn it back on.</litem><litem>For a <emph>smart plug</emph>?: Remove the smart plug from the wall socket, and then plug it back in.</litem><litem>For a <emph>lightstrip</emph> or <emph>string light</emph>: Stay within 3 ft of the RF box (the little box on the power cable).</litem></olist>
Still having trouble? Contact support, and they’ll help you out.
